text:
Carla (People Ops): Quick one — member in Berlin got a prosthetic orthotic fitted and clinic wants Redwood to direct-bill. They asked for a preauth number and if we can send ERA (electronic remittance advice) to their billing portal (they use a local payer connector) and accept payouts to a Stripe account (EU IBAN). Claim: 2026-DE-5577. Who owns this flow and what do we need?

Tomas (Benefits): Benefits owns coverage/preauth validation. We need the original preauth or service authorization reference (if any), signed AOB from member, itemized invoice with procedure codes/units, and the fitting report.

Priya (Finance): We do not currently pay vendors via Stripe as a primary AP rail — we require bank transfer to a verified IBAN. However, if provider wants payouts to a Stripe-linked account, they must provide a bank confirmation from Stripe showing the IBAN belongs to the clinic and a scanned W-8/W-9 equivalent for tax/KYC. AP will take extra KYC.

LegalBot: Automated: ERA delivery to third-party portals requires a DPA review if PHI will transit. If clinic requests EDI-style ERA, claims must redact identifiers or get member consent.

Tomas (Benefits): Also confirm if the prosthetic has prior authorization code; if not, benefits needs the clinical notes to adjudicate.

Carla (People Ops): Can someone paste a 2-line provider checklist/email I can forward that covers docs + Stripe note?

Priya (Finance): Paste: "Please send: 1) Signed Assignment of Benefits (AOB) for Claim 2026-DE-5577; 2) Itemized invoice and fitting report; 3) Clinic IBAN + BIC and confirmation from Stripe if you want payouts routed via Stripe (bank confirmation PDF); 4) Tax registration/VAT ID; 5) Billing portal endpoint for ERA + contact. Send to claims@redwood.com. Note: Stripe payouts require extra KYC and may delay payment"

ClaimsBot: Automated note — International/direct-bill workflow created. Manual review required. Expected timeline: 5-10 business days after complete docs + KYC.

Carla (People Ops): Perfect. I'll forward and ask member to sign AOB. One more — clinic asked if we can suppress member name on ERA but include invoice numbers. Allowed?

LegalBot: Automated reply — Member must provide written consent to initials-only or name suppression. Keep full record in claims file for audit.

Carla (People Ops): Thanks all — sending now. :white_check_mark:
